S_NOISE.description: Unusual grinding / squealing noise during cutting

S_FINISH.description: Poor surface finish on the machined part

S_HOT.description: Spindle housing or coolant hot to the touch

S_TRIP.description: Drive overload trip or lights dimming (voltage dip)

S_STALL.description: Spindle straining or stalling under load

TWF.name: Tool Wear Failure
TWF.detect: tool_wear_min near/above 200 min (failure at a random point in 200-240 min)

causes.C_ABRASIVE_WEAR: Normal abrasive wear at end of tool life
causes.C_EXCESS_CUT_TIME: Excess cumulative cutting time without tool change
causes.C_WRONG_TOOL_GRADE: Tool grade unsuitable for the workpiece material

HDF.name: Heat Dissipation Failure
HDF.detect: (process - air temperature) < 8.6 K AND rotational speed < 1380 rpm

causes.C_FILTER_BLOCK: Blocked coolant filter or failing pump
causes.C_LOW_AIRFLOW: Poor heat removal at low spindle speed

PWF.name: Power Failure
PWF.detect: power = torque x omega < 3500 W or > 9000 W

OSF.name: Overstrain Failure
OSF.detect: tool_wear x torque > 11000 / 12000 / 13000 min*Nm for type L / M / H

causes.C_EXCESS_DOC: Excessive depth of cut or feed rate
causes.C_DULL_TOOL_LOAD: Worn tool raising the cutting load

RNF.name: Random Failure
RNF.detect: none - occurs with ~0.1 % probability irrespective of parameters
